title: NANSEN module data
description: Data a module keeps in a project, such as the annotations of the ophys module's FOV map: module-data/<module>/<name>.json. The revision goes up by one with every save, and a save that names an older revision is refused, so two clients do not overwrite each other.

text.description: The data, as JSON text: kept as text so that both languages give it back exactly as it was saved. Its shape is the module's.
